# eval2: probabilities, ensembles and cascades (generated by `scripts/ensemble_eval2.py`, $0)

1991 questions. Nothing here is fitted: the averages are fixed 50/50, and the cascade tables show the whole threshold curve (choose a threshold on validation, never on eval2).

## How confident are the models

| model | eval2 | probabilities in (0.05, 0.95) | errors | errors with margin < 0.2 | errors with margin ≥ 0.4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| jev | 97.2 | 19.3% | 55 | 34 | 7 |
| qwen35_4b_tree | 95.6 | 8.9% | 88 | 39 | 23 |
| tree_4b_combo | 94.5 | 10.8% | 110 | 54 | 26 |
| qwen35_4b_r2x64 | 93.7 | 7.5% | 125 | 41 | 50 |
| eikos_4b | 92.8 | 46.8% | 144 | 77 | 12 |
| teacher_27b | 91.4 | 26.1% | 172 | 108 | 11 |

- Jev returns 106 distinct probability values, 5247 of 5254 are multiples of 0.01 (the API rounds to two decimals); most common: 0 (1604), 0.98 (499), 1 (490), 0.03 (292), 0.04 (291), 0.99 (286), 0.97 (211), 0.05 (206).
- Margin = |p − 0.5| (binary), top-1 − top-2 (multiclass), the least certain label's |p − 0.5| (multilabel).

## Where `qwen35_4b_tree` loses to Jev

- 64 questions Jev gets right and we get wrong: multilabel 29, binary 21, multiclass 14.
- On 31 of them our margin is below 0.2 and on 48 below 0.4: we are unsure on most of what we lose.
